text:
alex_r: Heads-up — we just saw an eviction wave in us-west1 that caused repeated spin-ups in the preemptible-gpu-pool and thundering drains across AZs. nodepool: preemptible-gpu-pool-1

eviction-bot: Instance termination notice: i-0a1b2c3d (g4dn.xlarge) in us-west1-b. Terminate in 120s.

maria_ops: Ugh. Are we seeing the autoscaler bounce? last 10m cluster-autoscaler logs show rapid add+delete.

alex_r: Yes — scale-up then scale-down loops. I think the issue is twofold: (1) our scale-down delay is too short for GPU workloads (pods still migrating/evicting), (2) scheduler is rebalancing across AZs causing cross-AZ drains.

jeff_sre: Can you paste the pods stuck in Terminating? also which drain command was used?

alex_r: Paste: ```kubectl get pods -n ml -o wide | egrep "preemptible-gpu"``` shows ~6 pods stuck Terminating with finalizers and PVC detach waiting. We used standard `kubectl drain` via the node-termination handler which sets --ignore-daemonsets but not --force.

maria_ops: Observed CV behavior: PVCDetachTimeout + kubelet slow eviction leads to nodes being removed from ASG before volumes detach => orphaned volumes and pod recreates on new nodes -> more scale churn.

sam_platform: Proposal: introduce a small capacity pad of on-demand gpus as a buffer per AZ (2 nodes each) and increase CA scale-down-unneeded-time to 10m for gpu pools. Also set cluster-autoscaler flag `--balance-similar-node-groups=true` and `--expander=least-waste` to avoid oscillation.

jeff_sre: +1 for capacity pad. We should also tweak kube-controller-manager `--pv-reclaim-timeout` is not the knob, it's the cloud provider detach timeout. For GCE that's 5m default — we saw timeouts. Increase detach retries/timeout in the node-termination handler.

maria_ops: Another idea: mark preemptible nodes with a taint `spot-preemptible=true:NoExecute` and update our pod `tolerations` to allow graceful eviction window 300s for long-running GPU pods. That prevents immediate eviction and gives time for checkpointing.

alex_r: Implementation plan:
1) Add 2 on-demand nodes per AZ in us-west1 to `on-demand-gpu-pad` nodepool (kube labels to prefer via NodeAffinity).
2) Update cluster-autoscaler flags for gpu nodepools: `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m` and `--balance-similar-node-groups=true`.
3) Update node-termination handler to extend drain timeout and retry PVC detach for 6m total.
4) Add a preemption-handling init sidecar to ML pods to checkpoint model shard state on SIGTERM (config via helm).

jeff_sre: Can we do a small canary in us-west1-c first? Add pad=1 then run a spike test with simulated terminations (eviction-bot can replay).

eviction-bot: replay scheduled: 2146790500 — will send 3 termination events spread across AZs.

maria_ops: I'll open a short runbook and add dashboards: preemptible evictions, scale-up latency, PVC detach time, pod restart rate. Also add alert if scale loops > 3 within 15m.

alex_r: Thanks — I'll kick off the canary change and post results here. :thumbsup:
